title: Microsoft Copilot: comment on a Page to ask Copilot questions or request edits
summary: Hold: the briefing overlooks published guidance identifying the Page as the grounding artifact and documenting governance beyond the creation policy. Its OneDrive licensing statement also omits the documented exception for an existing site after licence removal. The roadmap facts and control path are supported, and the Graph endpoint can apply settings when configured in applyOnce mode.
